```{r}
malig <- CellSelector(DimPlot(ss, group.by = "cloneSize", reduction = "umap"))
malig <- ss$barcode.unique[ss$RNA_snn_res.0.1 %in% c("0","2","3","4","6","8","11")]
malig <- ss$barcode.unique[ss$pred.cluster.malig == "malig"]

malig.add <- CellSelector(DimPlot(ss, group.by = "cloneSize", reduction = "umap"))
malig.remove <- CellSelector(DimPlot(ss, group.by = "cloneSize", reduction = "umap"))

malig.final <- c(malig, malig.add)
malig.final <- intersect(malig, malig.add)
malig.final <- setdiff(malig, malig.remove)
DimPlot(ss, reduction = "umap", cells.highlight = malig.final, sizes.highlight = 1)

malig <- malig.final

malig.all <- append(malig.all, malig)

saveRDS(malig.all, "~/hpchome/malig.all.final.rds")
#sample 82
```

```{r}
table(ss$cloneSize)
markers.malig <- FindMarkers(ss, ident.1 = "Hyperexpanded (0.1 < X <= 1)", group.by = "cloneSize")
#table(ss$mal)
markers.malig <- FindMarkers(ss, ident.1 = "hyper", ident.2 = "non_hyper", group.by = "hyper")
markers.malig$dif <- markers.malig$pct.1 - markers.malig$pct.2
markers.malig$gene <- rownames(markers.malig)

markers.malig.pos <- subset(markers.malig, avg_log2FC > 0)
markers.malig.neg <- subset(markers.malig, avg_log2FC < 0)

up <- head(rownames(markers.malig.pos), 50)
down <- head(rownames(markers.malig.neg), 50)

ss <- AddModuleScore(object = ss, features = list(up, down))
ss$pred.label <- ifelse(ss$Cluster1 > ss$Cluster2, "malig", "non_malig")

cl <- kmeans(ss@meta.data[, c("Cluster1", "Cluster2")], centers = 2)
ss$pred.cluster <- paste0("Cluster", cl$cluster)

cluster_means <- tapply(ss$Cluster1, ss$pred.cluster, mean)
malig_cluster <- names(which.max(cluster_means))

ss$pred.cluster.malig <- ifelse(ss$pred.cluster == malig_cluster, "malig", "non_malig")

DimPlot(ss, group.by = "cloneSize", reduction = "umap")
DimPlot(ss, group.by = "malig", reduction = "umap")
DimPlot(ss, group.by = "pred.label", reduction = "umap")
DimPlot(ss, group.by = "pred.cluster", reduction = "umap")
DimPlot(ss, group.by = "pred.cluster.malig", reduction = "umap")
FeaturePlot(ss, reduction = "umap", features = "Cluster1")
FeaturePlot(ss, reduction = "umap", features = "Cluster2")

up
```

go <- enrichGO(gene = up, OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db", keyType = "SYMBOL", ont = "ALL", universe = markers.malig$gene)

ss <- FindClusters(ss, resolution = 0.1)

markers.tmp$dif <- markers.tmp$pct.1 - markers.tmp$pct.2
markers.tmp$gene <- rownames(markers.tmp)

markers.tmp2 <- arrange(markers.tmp, desc(dif))
